verdict.rationale: Notion is a workspace and project-tracking tool, so release-changelog automation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no feature that auto-generates a changelog per release. The REST API, webhooks, GitHub sync, and agents are only developer building blocks or adjacent features that could be used to construct such a workflow, and they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
